metadata.title: A Fast Iterative Shrinkage-Thresholding Algorithm for Linear Inverse Problems
metadata.source_note: Extracted from PDF->text fallback; .tex source not available. Math fidelity reduced.

nodes.name: Linear Inverse Problem
nodes.statement: Estimate unknown signal $x$ from observations $Ax = b + w$, where $A \in \mathbb{R}^{m \times n}$, $b \in \mathbb{R}^m$ are known and $w$ is an unknown noise vector.
nodes.statement_clean: Recover the true signal x from a noisy linear measurement model Ax = b + w.

nodes.name: Least Squares (LS) Problem
nodes.statement: $\hat{x}_{LS} = \arg\min_x \|Ax - b\|^2$.
nodes.statement_clean: Choose the estimator that minimizes the squared data error.

nodes.name: Tikhonov Regularization
nodes.statement: $\hat{x}_{TIK} = \arg\min_x \{\|Ax - b\|^2 + \lambda \|Lx\|^2\}$, with regularization parameter $\lambda > 0$.
nodes.statement_clean: Add a quadratic penalty to the LS objective to stabilize ill-conditioned problems.

nodes.name: $\ell_1$-Regularized Least Squares Problem
nodes.statement: $\min_x \{F(x) \equiv \|Ax - b\|^2 + \lambda \|x\|_1\}$, where $\|x\|_1 = \sum_i |x_i|$.
nodes.statement_clean: Minimize least-squares fit plus an l1 penalty to induce sparsity in x.

nodes.name: General Composite Convex Problem (P)
nodes.statement: $(P)\quad \min_x \{F(x) \equiv f(x) + g(x) : x \in \mathbb{R}^n\}$, with $f$ smooth convex and $g$ continuous convex (possibly nonsmooth).
nodes.statement_clean: Generic convex problem: minimize the sum of a smooth convex f and a possibly nonsmooth convex g.

nodes.name: Standing Assumptions on (P)
nodes.statement:
(i) $g: \mathbb{R}^n 	o \mathbb{R}$ is continuous convex (possibly nonsmooth); (ii) $f: \mathbb{R}^n 	o \mathbb{R}$ is $C^{1,1}$ with Lipschitz gradient $\|
abla f(x) - 
abla f(y)\| \le L(f) \|x - y\|$; (iii) $X_* := \arg\min F 
e \emptyset$, and for $x_* \in X_*$ set $F_* := F(x_*)$.
nodes.statement_clean: g is convex continuous; f is convex with L-Lipschitz gradient; the problem has a solution.

nodes.name: Shrinkage (Soft-Threshold) Operator
nodes.statement: $\mathcal{T}_\alpha: \mathbb{R}^n \to \mathbb{R}^n$ defined componentwise by $\mathcal{T}_\alpha(x)_i = (|x_i| - \alpha)_+ \, \mathrm{sgn}(x_i)$.
nodes.statement_clean: Componentwise soft-thresholding: shrink each coordinate by alpha and set to zero if smaller.

nodes.name: Quadratic Approximation $Q_L(x,y)$
nodes.statement: For any $L > 0$, $Q_L(x,y) := f(y) + \langle x - y, \nabla f(y) \rangle + \frac{L}{2} \|x - y\|^2 + g(x)$.
nodes.statement_clean: Quadratic upper-bound model of F at y: linearize f and add an L/2 proximal term plus g(x).

nodes.name: Proximal-Type Map $p_L(y)$
nodes.statement: $p_L(y) := \arg\min_{x \in \mathbb{R}^n} Q_L(x, y) = \arg\min_x \{ g(x) + \frac{L}{2} \| x - (y - \frac{1}{L} \nabla f(y)) \|^2 \}$.
nodes.statement_clean: The unique minimizer of the quadratic approximation Q_L(x, y); a proximal/forward-backward step.

nodes.name: Smooth Unconstrained Case ($g \equiv 0$)
nodes.statement: When $g(x) \equiv 0$, problem (P) reduces to the general unconstrained smooth convex minimization $\min_x f(x)$.
nodes.statement_clean: Setting g = 0 recovers ordinary smooth convex minimization.

nodes.name: $\ell_1$-Regularization as Special Case of (P)
nodes.statement: Problem (1.3) is an instance of (P) with $f(x) = \|Ax - b\|^2$ and $g(x) = \|x\|_1$. The smallest Lipschitz constant of $\nabla f$ is $L(f) = 2 \lambda_{\max}(A^T A)$.
nodes.statement_clean: The l1-LS problem fits the framework with f = squared residual and g = l1 norm; L(f) = 2 lambda_max(A^T A).

nodes.name: Cameraman Deblurring
nodes.statement: On a $256 \times 256$ cameraman image with $9 \times 9$ Gaussian blur ($\sigma = 4$) and additive Gaussian noise ($\sigma = 10^{-3}$), with $\lambda = 2 \times 10^{-5}$ and a three-stage Haar wavelet transform, FISTA achieves $F_{100} = 2.40 \times 10^{-1}$ vs ISTA $5.44 \times 10^{-1}$ and MTWIST $3.09 \times 10^{-1}$.
nodes.statement_clean: Wavelet-based deblurring of the cameraman image: FISTA reaches lower function values than ISTA and MTWIST.

nodes.name: Simple Test Image Deblurring
nodes.statement: On a $256 \times 256$ image from the regularization toolbox blur function with $\lambda = 10^{-4}$, FISTA at iteration 100 reaches $F = 0.321$, beating ISTA ($0.427$) and MTWIST ($0.341$) at iteration 200; FISTA reaches accuracy $\approx 10^{-7}$ after 10000 iterations vs $10^{-3}$ (ISTA) and $10^{-4}$ (MTWIST) on a noiseless $64 \times 64$ variant.
nodes.statement_clean: On a synthetic blurred image FISTA dramatically outperforms ISTA and MTWIST in iterations to reach a target accuracy.

nodes.name: Descent Lemma for $C^{1,1}$ Functions
nodes.statement: Let $f: \mathbb{R}^n \to \mathbb{R}$ be continuously differentiable with Lipschitz gradient and constant $L(f)$. Then for any $L \ge L(f)$: $f(x) \le f(y) + \langle x - y, \nabla f(y) \rangle + \frac{L}{2}\|x - y\|^2$ for every $x, y \in \mathbb{R}^n$.
conclusions: $f(x) \le f(y) + \langle x - y, \nabla f(y) \rangle + \frac{L}{2}\|x - y\|^2$ for all $x, y$

nodes.name: Optimality Characterization of $p_L(\cdot)$
nodes.statement: For any $y \in \mathbb{R}^n$, $z = p_L(y)$ if and only if there exists $\gamma(y) \in \partial g(z)$ such that $\nabla f(y) + L(z - y) + \gamma(y) = 0$.
conclusions: $z = p_L(y)$ iff $\exists \gamma(y) \in \partial g(z)$ with $\nabla f(y) + L(z - y) + \gamma(y) = 0$

nodes.name: Key Three-Point Inequality
nodes.statement: Let $y \in \mathbb{R}^n$ and $L > 0$ satisfy $F(p_L(y)) \le Q(p_L(y), y)$. Then for any $x \in \mathbb{R}^n$: $F(x) - F(p_L(y)) \ge \frac{L}{2}\|p_L(y) - y\|^2 + L \langle y - x, p_L(y) - y \rangle$.
conclusions: $F(x) - F(p_L(y)) \ge \frac{L}{2}\|p_L(y) - y\|^2 + L\langle y - x, p_L(y) - y\rangle$ for all $x$

nodes.name: Proof of Lemma 2.3
nodes.statement: Combine convexity of $f, g$ at $y$ and at $p_L(y)$, the optimality condition (Lemma 2.2), and the definition of $Q$ to obtain the stated lower bound.

nodes.name: Apply sufficient-decrease hypothesis
nodes.statement: From $F(p_L(y)) \le Q(p_L(y), y)$ obtain $F(x) - F(p_L(y)) \ge F(x) - Q(p_L(y), y)$.

nodes.name: Lower-bound $F(x)$ via convexity
nodes.statement: Using convexity of $f$ at $y$ and of $g$ at $p_L(y)$ with subgradient $\gamma(y)$: $F(x) \ge f(y) + \langle x - y, \nabla f(y)\rangle + g(p_L(y)) + \langle x - p_L(y), \gamma(y)\rangle$.

nodes.name: Insert definition of $Q(p_L(y), y)$
nodes.statement: Substitute $Q(p_L(y), y) = f(y) + \langle p_L(y) - y, \nabla f(y)\rangle + \frac{L}{2}\|p_L(y) - y\|^2 + g(p_L(y))$ and use Lemma 2.2 to replace $\nabla f(y) + \gamma(y)$ with $L(y - p_L(y))$.

nodes.name: Algebraic simplification
nodes.statement: Collect terms to obtain $F(x) - F(p_L(y)) \ge \frac{L}{2}\|p_L(y) - y\|^2 + L\langle y - x, p_L(y) - y\rangle$.

nodes.name: ISTA with Constant Stepsize
nodes.statement: Iterative shrinkage-thresholding algorithm for problem (P): repeatedly apply $x_k = p_L(x_{k-1})$ with $L = L(f)$.
output: Sequence $\{x_k\}$ converging to a minimizer of $F$
nodes.pseudocode:
Step 0. Take $x_0 \in \mathbb{R}^n$.
Step k ($k \ge 1$): Compute $x_k = p_L(x_{k-1})$.

nodes.name: Initialize $x_0$
nodes.statement: Set $x_0 \in \mathbb{R}^n$ arbitrarily; receive Lipschitz constant $L = L(f)$.

nodes.name: Proximal/shrinkage update
nodes.statement: For $k \ge 1$: compute $x_k = p_L(x_{k-1})$. For the $\ell_1$ case this becomes $x_k = \mathcal{T}_{\lambda/L}(x_{k-1} - \frac{1}{L} \nabla f(x_{k-1}))$.

nodes.name: ISTA with Backtracking
nodes.statement: ISTA variant where the stepsize $1/L_k$ is chosen by a backtracking line search to satisfy a sufficient-decrease condition $F(p_{\bar L}(x_{k-1})) \le Q_{\bar L}(p_{\bar L}(x_{k-1}), x_{k-1})$.
output: Sequence $\{x_k\}$ converging to a minimizer of $F$
nodes.pseudocode:
Step 0. Take $L_0 > 0$, $\eta > 1$, $x_0$.
Step k: Find smallest integer $i_k \ge 0$ such that with $\bar L = \eta^{i_k} L_{k-1}$: $F(p_{\bar L}(x_{k-1})) \le Q_{\bar L}(p_{\bar L}(x_{k-1}), x_{k-1})$.
Set $L_k = \eta^{i_k} L_{k-1}$, $x_k = p_{L_k}(x_{k-1})$.

nodes.name: Initialize $L_0, \eta, x_0$
nodes.statement: Choose $L_0 > 0$, $\eta > 1$, $x_0 \in \mathbb{R}^n$.

nodes.name: Backtracking line search
nodes.statement: Find smallest $i_k \ge 0$ such that $\bar L = \eta^{i_k} L_{k-1}$ satisfies $F(p_{\bar L}(x_{k-1})) \le Q_{\bar L}(p_{\bar L}(x_{k-1}), x_{k-1})$.

nodes.name: Set $L_k$ and update $x_k$
nodes.statement: Set $L_k = \eta^{i_k} L_{k-1}$ and $x_k = p_{L_k}(x_{k-1})$.

nodes.name: Monotonicity of ISTA Function Values
nodes.statement: The sequence $\{F(x_k)\}$ produced by ISTA is nonincreasing: for every $k \ge 1$, $F(x_k) \le Q_{L_k}(x_k, x_{k-1}) \le Q_{L_k}(x_{k-1}, x_{k-1}) = F(x_{k-1})$.

nodes.name: Bounds on $L_k$
nodes.statement: For both stepsize rules, $\beta L(f) \le L_k \le \alpha L(f)$, with $\alpha = \beta = 1$ in the constant case and $\alpha = \eta$, $\beta = L_0/L(f)$ in the backtracking case.

nodes.name: $O(1/k)$ Convergence Rate of ISTA
nodes.statement: Let $\{x_k\}$ be generated by ISTA (constant or backtracking stepsize). Then for any $k \ge 1$: $F(x_k) - F(x_*) \le \frac{\alpha L(f) \|x_0 - x_*\|^2}{2k}$ for all $x_* \in X_*$, with $\alpha = 1$ (constant) or $\alpha = \eta$ (backtracking).
conclusions: $F(x_k) - F(x_*) \le \frac{\alpha L(f) \|x_0 - x_*\|^2}{2k}$ for all $k \ge 1$ and any $x_* \in X_*$

nodes.name: Proof of Theorem 3.1
nodes.statement: Apply Lemma 2.3 twice (with $x = x_*$ and with $x = y = x_n$), telescope the resulting inequalities over $n = 0, \ldots, k-1$, and combine with the bounds on $L_k$ from Remark 3.2.

nodes.name: First application of Lemma 2.3
nodes.statement: Set $x = x_*$, $y = x_n$, $L = L_{n+1}$ in Lemma 2.3 to get $\frac{2}{L_{n+1}}(F(x_*) - F(x_{n+1})) \ge \|x_* - x_{n+1}\|^2 - \|x_* - x_n\|^2$, then use $L_{n+1} \ge \beta L(f)$.

nodes.name: Telescope to bound $kF(x_*) - \sum F(x_{n+1})$
nodes.statement: Sum the previous inequality over $n = 0, \ldots, k-1$ to obtain $\frac{2}{\alpha L(f)}(kF(x_*) - \sum_{n=0}^{k-1} F(x_{n+1})) \ge \|x_* - x_k\|^2 - \|x_* - x_0\|^2$.

nodes.name: Second application of Lemma 2.3
nodes.statement: Apply Lemma 2.3 with $x = y = x_n$, $L = L_{n+1}$ to get $\frac{2}{L_{n+1}}(F(x_n) - F(x_{n+1})) \ge \|x_n - x_{n+1}\|^2$, multiply by $n$ and sum to bound $-kF(x_k) + \sum F(x_{n+1})$.

nodes.name: Combine telescoped sums
nodes.statement: Add the two telescoped sums (with weight $\beta/\alpha$) to obtain $\frac{2k}{\alpha L(f)}(F(x_*) - F(x_k)) \ge -\|x_* - x_0\|^2$, yielding $F(x_k) - F(x_*) \le \frac{\alpha L(f) \|x_0 - x_*\|^2}{2k}$.

nodes.name: FISTA with Constant Stepsize
nodes.statement: Fast iterative shrinkage-thresholding algorithm: applies $p_L$ at an extrapolated point $y_k$ rather than $x_{k-1}$, achieving $O(1/k^2)$ rate.

nodes.name: Initialize $y_1, x_0, t_1$
nodes.statement: Set $y_1 = x_0 \in \mathbb{R}^n$ and $t_1 = 1$.

nodes.name: Proximal step at extrapolated point
nodes.statement: Compute $x_k = p_L(y_k)$ (a single proximal/shrinkage step at the auxiliary point $y_k$).

nodes.name: Update momentum parameter $t_{k+1}$
nodes.statement: Compute $t_{k+1} = \frac{1 + \sqrt{1 + 4 t_k^2}}{2}$, satisfying $t_k^2 = t_{k+1}^2 - t_{k+1}$.

nodes.name: Extrapolation step for $y_{k+1}$
nodes.statement: Set $y_{k+1} = x_k + \frac{t_k - 1}{t_{k+1}}(x_k - x_{k-1})$, a linear combination of the two previous iterates.

nodes.name: FISTA with Backtracking
nodes.statement: FISTA variant in which the Lipschitz constant is estimated by backtracking on the sufficient-decrease condition at $y_k$.
nodes.pseudocode:
Step 0. $L_0 > 0$, $\eta > 1$, $x_0 \in \mathbb{R}^n$, $y_1 = x_0$, $t_1 = 1$.
Step k: Find smallest $i_k$ such that with $\bar L = \eta^{i_k} L_{k-1}$: $F(p_{\bar L}(y_k)) \le Q_{\bar L}(p_{\bar L}(y_k), y_k)$.
Set $L_k = \eta^{i_k} L_{k-1}$, $x_k = p_{L_k}(y_k)$, then update $t_{k+1}, y_{k+1}$ as above.

nodes.name: Recursive Relation for FISTA
nodes.statement: The sequences $\{x_k, y_k\}$ generated by FISTA (constant or backtracking) satisfy, for every $k \ge 1$: $\frac{2}{L_k} t_k^2 v_k - \frac{2}{L_{k+1}} t_{k+1}^2 v_{k+1} \ge \|u_{k+1}\|^2 - \|u_k\|^2$, where $v_k := F(x_k) - F(x_*)$ and $u_k := t_k x_k - (t_k - 1) x_{k-1} - x_*$.
assumptions: FISTA iterates $\{x_k, y_k\}$ with the update $t_k^2 = t_{k+1}^2 - t_{k+1}$

nodes.name: Proof of Lemma 4.1
nodes.statement: Apply Lemma 2.3 at $(x_k, y_{k+1})$ and $(x_*, y_{k+1})$, combine via the recursion $t_k^2 = t_{k+1}^2 - t_{k+1}$, then use the Pythagoras identity to assemble the recursive bound.

nodes.name: Two applications of Lemma 2.3 at $y_{k+1}$
nodes.statement: Apply Lemma 2.3 with $(x := x_k, y := y_{k+1}, L = L_{k+1})$ and with $(x := x_*, y := y_{k+1}, L = L_{k+1})$ using $x_{k+1} = p_{L_{k+1}}(y_{k+1})$.

nodes.name: Combine via the $t$-recursion
nodes.statement: Multiply the first inequality by $(t_{k+1} - 1)$ and add to the second; then multiply by $t_{k+1}$ and use $t_k^2 = t_{k+1}^2 - t_{k+1}$.

nodes.name: Use $L_{k+1} \ge L_k$
nodes.statement: Express both sides in terms of $u_k := t_k x_k - (t_k - 1) x_{k-1} - x_*$ and use $L_{k+1} \ge L_k$ to obtain the stated inequality.

nodes.name: Telescoping Lemma for Positive Sequences
nodes.statement: Let $\{a_k, b_k\}$ be positive sequences satisfying $a_k - a_{k+1} \ge b_{k+1} - b_k$ for all $k \ge 1$, with $a_1 + b_1 \le c$, $c > 0$. Then $a_k \le c$ for every $k \ge 1$.

nodes.name: Lower Bound on $t_k$
nodes.statement: The positive sequence $\{t_k\}$ generated in FISTA via $t_{k+1} = (1 + \sqrt{1 + 4 t_k^2})/2$ with $t_1 = 1$ satisfies $t_k \ge (k+1)/2$ for all $k \ge 1$.

nodes.name: $O(1/k^2)$ Convergence Rate of FISTA
nodes.statement: Let $\{x_k\}, \{y_k\}$ be generated by FISTA. Then for any $k \ge 1$: $F(x_k) - F(x_*) \le \frac{2 \alpha L(f) \|x_0 - x_*\|^2}{(k+1)^2}$ for all $x_* \in X_*$, with $\alpha = 1$ (constant stepsize) or $\alpha = \eta$ (backtracking).
conclusions: $F(x_k) - F(x_*) \le \frac{2 \alpha L(f) \|x_0 - x_*\|^2}{(k+1)^2}$ for any $x_* \in X_*$

nodes.name: Proof of Theorem 4.4
nodes.statement: Set $a_k := \frac{2}{L_k} t_k^2 v_k$, $b_k := \|u_k\|^2$, $c := \|x_0 - x_*\|^2$. By Lemma 4.1, $a_k - a_{k+1} \ge b_{k+1} - b_k$. Verify $a_1 + b_1 \le c$ via Lemma 2.3 at $(x_*, y_1)$, apply Lemma 4.2, then use $t_k \ge (k+1)/2$ (Lemma 4.3) and the upper bound on $L_k$.

nodes.name: Invoke Lemma 4.2
nodes.statement: Lemma 4.1 gives $a_k - a_{k+1} \ge b_{k+1} - b_k$, and the base case is $a_1 + b_1 \le c$. By Lemma 4.2, $a_k \le c$ for all $k$, i.e., $\frac{2}{L_k} t_k^2 v_k \le \|x_0 - x_*\|^2$.

nodes.name: Apply $t_k \ge (k+1)/2$ and bound on $L_k$
nodes.statement: Combine $t_k \ge (k+1)/2$ (Lemma 4.3) and $L_k \le \alpha L(f)$ to obtain $v_k \le \frac{2 L_k \|x_0 - x_*\|^2}{(k+1)^2} \le \frac{2 \alpha L(f) \|x_0 - x_*\|^2}{(k+1)^2}$.

nodes.name: ISTA $\ell_1$ Iteration
nodes.statement: $x_{k+1} = \mathcal{T}_{\lambda t}\bigl(x_k - 2 t A^T (A x_k - b)\bigr)$, with $t$ a stepsize and $\mathcal{T}_\alpha$ the shrinkage operator (1.5).

nodes.name: Proximal Form of $p_L(y)$
nodes.statement: $p_L(y) = \arg\min_x \{ g(x) + \frac{L}{2} \| x - (y - \frac{1}{L} \nabla f(y)) \|^2 \}$.

nodes.name: Hilbert Space and Constrained Extension
nodes.statement: All results extend to any real Hilbert space and to problem (P) with convex constraints; the constrained case requires that $p_L(\cdot)$ remain easy to compute (e.g., when the feasible set is the nonnegative orthant).

nodes.name: Iteration Complexity
nodes.statement: ISTA needs $\lceil C/\varepsilon \rceil$ iterations for an $\varepsilon$-optimal solution with $C = \alpha L(f) \|x_0 - x_*\|^2 / 2$, whereas FISTA needs $\lceil C'/\sqrt{\varepsilon} - 1 \rceil$ with $C' = \sqrt{2 \alpha L(f) \|x_0 - x_*\|^2}$, a strict improvement.
